reorder: Owned the end-to-end UX process across assigned modules, creating user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes and development-ready high-fidelity interfaces in Figma.

Designed a Partner Portal from the ground up for Sales and Customer personas, creating dashboards and workflows for leads, partners and customers while iterating designs based on stakeholder feedback.

Designed and shipped responsive web and mobile experiences for core HRMS products including Task Management, Timesheet, Leave and Attendance, translating user and business requirements into intuitive digital workflows.
Worked within existing product patterns and reusable components to maintain consistency across the HRMS platform while identifying opportunities to improve workflows and interaction patterns.
Collaborated with product stakeholders and developers to refine requirements, validate design feasibility and support implementation across desktop and mobile experiences.
Conducted interviews and usability testing with HR administrators, managers and employees, synthesizing findings into actionable UX improvements and interface decisions.
Delivered the full UX process for an education-sector CRM aimed at schools - research, user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes.
Produced marketing posters and graphics that supported the company's branding and campaign outreach.
Conducted user research for a news application and packaged the findings into a documented case study that guided design decisions.
honesty: Rewrote the profile, reordered sections, and reworded and reordered base CV content only. No new experience, tools, employers, dates or metrics.
profile: UX/UI Designer with 2 years of industry experience owning the end-to-end design of responsive web and mobile products, from concepts and wireframes to production-ready interfaces in Figma, supported by an MSc in Design Innovation from Maynooth University. Designed dashboards and workflows for a Partner Portal, worked within a design system of reusable components, and produced marketing posters and graphics. Strong at presenting design decisions, iterating on stakeholder feedback and collaborating closely with developers.
